    Welcome to GypsyPlate, here are some of our favorites:

    Puerto Rican Picadillo

    Picadillo is a classic, home-style, Latin American dish. There are many variations, but this Puerto Rican version is my favorite so far!

    Lowcountry Shrimp and Grits

    Lowcountry Shrimp and Grits is an amazing comfort food. Plump shrimp and smoky sausage are smothered in a savory gravy and served over creamy, cheesy grits.

    Caldo de Res (Mexican Beef & Vegetable Soup)

    Caldo de Res is a flavorful Mexican beef and vegetable soup tat simmers for hours in a beautiful homemade broth.
